# Dockable Panel > Non-modal workspace panel that moves between two explicit edge slots with a mobile Drawer fallback. Status: experimental. This file matches the installed `dockable-panel` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/dockable-panel.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/dockable-panel.md`. ## Registry dependencies - `button` - `core` - `drawer` - `live-status` - `scroll-area` - `sidebar` - `typography` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/button-knobs`: `buttonKnobs`, types `ButtonKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/dockable-panel-knobs`: `dockablePanelKnobs`, types `DockablePanelKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/dockable-panel-geometry`: `clampDockablePanelPosition`, `dockablePanelSideAt`, `oppositeDockablePanelSide`, `dockablePanelSideForKey`, types `DockablePanelBounds`, `DockablePanelSize`, `DockablePanelPosition` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/dockable-panel`: `DockablePanel`, `DockablePanelHeader`, `DockablePanelDragHandle`, `DockablePanelTitle`, `DockablePanelActions`, `DockablePanelToggle`, `DockablePanelDock`, `DockablePanelClose`, `DockablePanelContent`, types `DockablePanelPlacement`, `DockablePanelProps`, `DockablePanelHeaderProps`, `DockablePanelDragHandleProps`, `DockablePanelTitleProps`, `DockablePanelActionsProps`, `DockablePanelToggleProps`, `DockablePanelDockProps`, `DockablePanelCloseProps`, `DockablePanelContentPadding`, `DockablePanelContentProps` ## Composition ### Workspace panel ```tsx ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { useRef, useState } from "react"; import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button"; import { DockablePanel, DockablePanelActions, DockablePanelClose, DockablePanelContent, DockablePanelDock, DockablePanelDragHandle, DockablePanelHeader, DockablePanelTitle, DockablePanelToggle, } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/dockable-panel"; import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography"; export function PrimitiveDockablePanelExample() { const [open, setOpen] = useState(true); const openerRef = useRef(null); return (
Selection Drag the title to reveal both side slots, then release over either half. From the keyboard, focus the title and press the arrow keys, or use the placement buttons.
); } function PanelRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) { return (
{label} {value}
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `dockable-panel` - `actions` - `content`: `data-padding` (`default` | `none`) - `drag-button` - `drag-handle` - `drop-zone`: `data-active`, `data-side` (`left` | `right`) - `header` - `root`: `data-dragging`, `data-placement` (`left` | `right`) - `title` ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### dockable-panel - `--cui-dockable-panel-radius`: `min( var(--radius-panel), calc(var(--control-h-sm) / 2 + var(--_dockable-panel-header-inset) + var(--cui-dockable-panel-border-width)) )` - `--cui-dockable-panel-background`: `var(--card)` - `--cui-dockable-panel-foreground`: `var(--card-foreground)` - `--cui-dockable-panel-border-color`: `oklch(from var(--border) l c h / 0.8)` - `--cui-dockable-panel-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)` - `--cui-dockable-panel-shadow`: `var(--shadow-pop)` - `--cui-dockable-panel-dragging-shadow`: `var(--shadow-modal)` - `--cui-dockable-panel-drop-zone-active-background`: `oklch(from var(--primary) l c h / 0.12)` - `--cui-dockable-panel-drop-zone-active-border-color`: `oklch(from var(--primary) l c h / 0.55)` - `--cui-dockable-panel-drop-zone-background`: `oklch(from var(--background) l c h / 0.12)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/dockable-panel - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/dockable-panel.json
